component.name: Deskemy
component.summary: Offline player for the video courses you already own

description.p: Point Deskemy at a folder of downloaded course videos and it becomes a library: sections and lectures in order, progress kept, and every lecture resumed where you left it. Your files stay where they are; nothing is copied or uploaded.

ul.li: Subtitles and resources (PDFs, code, archives) next to their lectures, with a built-in PDF viewer
A mini player that stays on top beside your editor
Bookmarks, chapters, a sleep timer and YouTube-style keyboard shortcuts
Search across courses, lectures, resources and spoken subtitle text
Watch history, streaks and a daily goal

screenshot.caption: The player with the course's contents beside it
A course's sections, lectures and resources

description.p: Resources can pop up before a lecture ends, bookmarks on the seek bar, search grouped by kind and as you type, and skips that land where you send them.
A built-in PDF viewer, drag and drop import, and pairing a resource with any lecture by hand.
